title: Review of the hunting ecology (SIEXD) on fresh seed 8 at 256^2: predators crash the prey 65 -> 1 and let them recover to 50 against a static twin growing to 84, predators divide (17 persistent splits, generation 2), and a fuel cut dissolves every prey body; prey never divide persistently
summary: labkit at the claim's settings (256^2, t=12000, --lineage-k 5), seed 8: prey n every 500 t 18, 60, 63, 63, 65, 35, 1, 4, 15, 39, 49, 50, 47, 36, ... 24 (predator noise added at t=2000); predators 63-79 falling to 40; predator persistent splits 17, generation 2, merge/split 0.08; prey persistent splits 0. Predator-free twin (pred_on 0, same seed and settings): prey 58 -> 84, static, 15 persistent splits of generation 1 early in the run. Fuel cut at t=6000 (drive.py, 128^2, seed 8): prey 9 -> 4 -> 3 -> 0 at t=6000/6200/6400/6600, emax 0.91 -> 0.45, prey material 0.214 -> 0.201 by t=7000 (some eaten), against the fed run's 9 -> 6 -> 7 -> 6 (prey are also being eaten there); predators 23 in both.

observations.S: pack256/sheet.png t=0: prey noise over the whole box; prey droplets by t=500; predator noise added over the whole box at t=2000
observations.I: pack256/sheet.png t=2600-12000: discrete predator droplets (orange) and prey droplets visible throughout; labkit tracks are short because predators dim between meals (2 and 3 persistent tracks)
observations.X: pack256 vs twin256 (seed 8, same grid, duration, window): prey 65 -> 1 at t=3000 and back to 50 by t=5500, then 13-24, against 58 -> 84 static; predators lower prey number and make it swing
observations.D: predators: 17 persistent splits, generation 2 (from noise-formed founders), merge/split 0.08 (pack256/FACTS.md, lineage.png); prey: 0 persistent splits
observations.E: efork_s8.txt: fuel cut at t=6000 dissolves every prey body by t=6600 with the prey material kept in solution; fed run keeps 6-7

seeds_run.result: pass for predators' D, X and prey E; prey D not seen (0 persistent prey splits)

verdicts.limitation: D is the predators' only: prey make 0 persistent splits with predators present (new prey nucleate from the bath), so the ecology reproduces on one trophic level. The populations show one crash and recovery and then a slow decline, not repeated cycles, on this seed. The prey E fork is noisy because the fed prey are also being eaten (fed 6 vs fork 0 at t=6600) and it is one seed at 128^2 with drive.py counts. Predator E holds by construction (made only from prey material), so the E I support is the prey's. The predators' hunting uses a written nonreciprocal drift toward low fuel. One fresh seed; no Laplacian-only twin.
